x-script-docs._note: See DATA_WORKFLOW.md for the full raw-data, generated-data, and wiki-blueprint workflow.
x-script-docs.dev: Run the Vite development server for local UI work.
x-script-docs.build: Type-check and produce a production build.
x-script-docs.validate:sources: Run source validation checks for acquisition/source data.
x-script-docs.validate:external-data: Strictly validate synchronized WFCD raw files, resolved components, the All.json aggregate, and drop-data records.
x-script-docs.audit:unknown-sources: Audit unknown acquisition and blueprint-source gaps, then emit markdown and JSON reports for follow-up fixes.
x-script-docs.audit:prerequisites: Print a Markdown inventory of prerequisite entries, dependencies, provenance coverage, and graph integrity.
x-script-docs.update:data: Safely refresh WFCD item, drop, and curated Public Export Plus raw-data folders from pinned GitHub sources.
x-script-docs.update:data:check: Discover, download, and validate all configured upstream datasets without replacing any workspace files.
x-script-docs.update:data:warframe-items: Safely refresh the discovered WFCD item categories and generated All.json.
x-script-docs.update:data:drop-data: Safely refresh the discovered WFCD drop-data JSON files.
x-script-docs.update:data:public-export-plus: Safely refresh the curated Public Export Plus item, upgrade, and English localization maps.
x-script-docs.generate:warframe-items-all: Rebuild the complete WFCD All.json aggregate from discovered category data and Components.json.
x-script-docs.generate:public-export-identities: Generate missing exact item and upgrade identities from the pinned Public Export Plus snapshot, using explicit path labels when recipe names are unavailable.
x-script-docs.generate:legacy-upgrades: Generate last-resort exact upgrade identities from the pinned MIT-licensed 2018 catalog when maintained catalogs have no record.
x-script-docs.generate:wiki-blueprints: Convert the Lua-style wiki blueprint dump in external/wiki/blueprintsDatabase.txt into generated JSON for app use.
x-script-docs.generate:data: Regenerate all primary _generated data artifacts from external sources, including current and legacy identity supplements, the unified acquisition index, and lean All.json/relic runtime subsets.
x-script-docs.refresh:data: Run the raw-data updater and then regenerate all derived _generated artifacts.
x-script-docs.benchmark:build-planner: Measure optimizer latency, build legality, Forma use, score consistency, and deterministic build selection across a representative weapon corpus; the --verify-arcane-selection flag checks arcane rank optimality for each returned fixed mod set.
x-script-docs.benchmark:planner-comparison: Re-score the captured Braton Prime Tenno-Hub and Underframe builds with identical target pools and the same finite expected encounter model.
x-script-docs.benchmark:torid-comparison: Compare the saved Underframe Torid QA build with Tenno-Hub's Scaling optimizer on the captured Corpus target.
